modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: Console-script startup: load environment settings, construct the order repository, initialize the SQLite schema, and announce readiness.

modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Immutable Settings definition and environment-to-settings translation.

modules.name: minisvc.models
modules.purpose: Order domain dataclass carrying order_id, customer, and total_cents.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: SQLite-backed OrderRepository for schema creation, inserts, and lookups.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Bind POST and GET order endpoints to handler functions.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Translate request payloads and repository results into create/get response dictionaries and generated event data.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Build in-memory order event dictionaries; it does not persist audit records.

key_functions.importance: Process entry point; wires configuration and storage, initializes schema, and returns 0.
key_functions.behavior: Reads os.environ indirectly through load_settings; does not start an HTTP server or enforce readonly.

key_functions.importance: Defines runtime database location and readonly setting.
key_functions.behavior: MINISVC_DB defaults to orders.sqlite; MINISVC_READONLY is true only for value 1.
Opens SQLite and inserts one Order; duplicate IDs and database errors propagate.
Queries by order_id and returns Order or None.
Registers POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> using lambdas.
Indexes required payload keys, converts total_cents with int, saves once, and returns a generated event.
Returns missing or serialized order response and generates a read event.
Returns a dictionary only; no table, file, or logging sink is used.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: load_settings selects MINISVC_DB or orders.sqlite and parses MINISVC_READONLY.
main calls repo.init_schema(), creating SQLite table orders if absent.

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order flow
steps: POST /orders dispatches through the registered lambda to create_order(payload, repo).
create_order reads order_id, customer, and total_cents and converts total_cents with int().
create_order constructs an Order and calls repo.save(order), which inserts into SQLite once.
create_order calls order_event(order, created) to build an in-memory event.
The handler returns status created, order_id, and event; no audit record is persisted.
